"''We're delivering Poggle to Coruscant, and Cestus is not exactly on the way.|[[Ki-Adi-Mundi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker]]|}} '''Ord Cestus''', also referred to as simply '''Cestus''', was a [[planet]][[Tarkin (novel)|''Tarkin'']] in the [[D'Astan sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories]]. Located in the vicinity of the [[Perlemian Trade Route]], it was situated a considerable distance away from common routes between [[Geonosis]] and [[Coruscant]].
